copies_note: Rulebook says 65 Spell cards. By_School has 65 clean scans: 61 distinct spells plus a second physical copy of Spell Shield (Conjuring), Spell Shield (Thaumaturgy), Trap! and Root Cellar (each copy was scanned at a different grid position; pixel-diff shows the faces are identical). No new spells were found beyond the 61 already transcribed. The 6 .jpeg files in By_School/necromancy are not spells (see other_cards_from_pc.json).
